theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_stab_det_second_order
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (κ : ℝ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ N → ∀ X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, (∀ i j, |X i j| ≤ κ) → (∀ i j, |Y i j| ≤ κ) → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 → |(1 + t • X + t ^ 2 • Y).det - (1 + t * X.trace + t ^ 2 * (Y.trace + (X.trace ^ 2 - (X * X).trace) / 2))| ≤ C * |t| ^ 3
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
